missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Крестьянин' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'работает'. 'Старый' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'в поле' is the prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Крестьянина' is the accusative object of 'встретили'. For an animate masculine noun the accusative copies the genitive ending -а.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Крестьянина' is genitive in the 'у' frame, showing whose family it is. The masculine genitive singular ending is -а.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Крестьянину' is the dative recipient, while 'землю' is the accusative object of 'дал'. The masculine dative ending is -у.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'С крестьянином' uses the instrumental form after 'с' to mean together with him. The masculine instrumental ending is -ом.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О крестьянине' uses the prepositional form 'крестьянине' after 'о' to express the topic. The masculine ending becomes -е.
Strategic focus: Irregular nominative plural. 'Крестьяне' is the nominative plural, with the irregular -яне ending replacing the singular -янин. 'Бедные' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Irregular genitive plural. 'Крестьян' is the genitive plural after 'нет', formed with the zero ending of the irregular -яне type. It expresses that there are none.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Крестьян' is the accusative plural object of 'собрал'. For animate nouns the accusative plural matches the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Крестьянин' is nominative as the subject, paired with the predicate noun 'человек'. 'Трудолюбивый' is the agreeing masculine adjective describing him.
